name: local-document-factory
description: One fact pack, four formats, one evidence gate: verified PDF, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX documents built locally.

commands.name: doc-brief
commands.description: Build a verified report-grade PDF brief from supplied facts
commands.template: Build a report-grade PDF brief about: {input}. Use build_document or create_pdf, include the source line, and call verify_artifact before reporting done.

commands.name: doc-editable
commands.description: Produce an editable DOCX from a brief or source notes
commands.template: Create an editable DOCX about: {input}. Use create_docx, preserve the source line, and verify the artifact.

commands.name: doc-workbook
commands.description: Turn supplied facts into an XLSX with inputs, model and outputs
commands.template: Build an XLSX model for: {input}. Use create_xlsx with separate Inputs, Model and Output sheets, formulas over hardcoded totals, then verify_artifact.

commands.name: doc-deck
commands.description: Turn a brief into a PPTX deck with speaker notes and QA
commands.template: Build a PPTX deck for: {input}. Use create_pptx_deck with one claim per slide and speaker notes, then call qa_pptx_deck and verify_artifact.

commands.name: doc-qa
commands.description: Run the document QA checklist over produced artifacts
commands.template: Run the document QA checklist over: {input}. Check the artifact contract, source line, page count, placeholders and verification evidence; report PASS or FAIL per item.

changelog: 1.0.0 - Local Document Factory: five-command suite with artifact contract, QA checklist and evidence gate.
